data.en: Last 100 draws: 7 appeared 22 times, the hottest, 39 only 4 times, the coldest, 38 5 times, tail 7 77 times, tail 0 49 times, zone 1-10 130 times, 11-20 135 times, 21-30 120 times, 31-40 109 times, 41-49 106 times, average sum 144.8, average span 34.4, consecutive rate 50%. Six technical steps. First, deviation: expected count per number is 10, 7 deviates +12, 39 deviates -6, large deviation calls for regression. Second, Bayesian: 100 draws as prior, last 10 as likelihood, posterior still high for 7 so ease it, low for 39 so bring it back, and 47 recovers to median so keep it. Third, entropy: tail distribution entropy shows tail 7 overheated, tails 1, 4, 6 underfilled, so fill tails 1, 4, 6. Fourth, sum distribution: sums 110-180 cover 78%, first group sum 144 sits on the peak, second group sum 171 sits on the right tail but still valid. Fifth, span distribution: spans 30-45 cover 71%, first group span 43, second group span 41, both in the main distribution. Sixth, consecutive Markov chain: no consecutive last time, next consecutive transition probability 50%, first group keeps 36 to 47 as cross-zone linkage, second group keeps 40 to 49 as tail linkage. First group 4, 11, 19, 27, 36, 47, sum 144, span 43, key picks 47 for Bayesian recovery, 36 for tail 6, 11 for tail 1; second group 8, 15, 26, 33, 40, 49, sum 171, span 41, key picks 49 for tail 9 entropy, 40 for tail 0, 26 to steady the middle. 本期2組：4,11,19,27,36,47、8,15,26,33,40,49

data.en: Qimen Dunjia: nine palaces spread stars, eight gates fly, eight deities follow the Chief Deity. The Chief Deity falls in the centre palace 5, calling for a stable layout, so 37 anchors the centre. The Envoy Gate falls on the Life Gate, which governs growth and wealth, in Gen palace 8, whose numbers are 2, 10, 18, 26, 37, 46, so the first group uses 2, 10, 18, 29, 37, 46 to answer the Life Gate, with 29 shifting from Hurt Gate to Life Gate, turning hurt into life. The Rest Gate falls in Kan palace 1, for rest, whose numbers are 1, 9, 17, 25, 33, 41, so the second group uses 5, 13, 22, 31, 39, 47 to shift Rest Gate to Open Gate, with 47 in Qian palace 6, metal generating water, Open Gate seeing water means opening. The Death Gate falls in Kun palace 2, not to be fully avoided but controlled by emptiness, emptiness on 38, off the Death Gate line, using emptiness to control substance. The Scenery Gate falls in Li palace 9, fire controlling metal, fire generating earth, 39 in centre earth, fire-earth mutual generation, so the second group keeps 39 for Scenery Gate. Teng Snake falls in Xun palace 4, for entanglement and change, whose numbers are 4, 12, 20, 28, entangling the Life Gate, change at 29. Tai Yin falls in Dui palace 7, for hidden help, whose numbers are 7, 15, 23, 31, so the second group keeps 31 for hidden help. No Fu Yin repetition this round, Fan Yin reversal still unfinished from last round, so 46 and 47 close with reversal. First group 2, 10, 18, 29, 37, 46, sum 142, span 44, key picks 37 Chief Deity centre, 46 Life Gate close, 29 hurt-to-life; second group 5, 13, 22, 31, 39, 47, sum 157, span 42, key picks 47 Open Gate water, 39 Scenery fire-earth, 31 Tai Yin hidden help. 本期2組：2,10,18,29,37,46、5,13,22,31,39,47

data.en: Tarot uses a three-card spread plus clarifiers, full 78 cards, 22 Major Arcana 0-21, 56 Minor Arcana in four elements.
